items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 26 at 7:02PM EST until November 27 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Jacksonville FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Duval County.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 27 at 1:47AM EST until November 27 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Jacksonville FL
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds around 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt.

* WHERE...Southeast Georgia and Northeast Florida coastal waters
from Altamaha Sound GA to Flagler Beach FL out to 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
